notes.title: Fixed bugs in game achievements.
notes.content:
Achievements and teleports.
There are a total of 10 levels and 9 achievements available in the game.
There are no achievements in the ninth level. We are temporarily unable to edit the source code. Currently, work is underway to introduce new features into the game engine.
All levels have been finalized, the level design has been improved.
Added teleports and micro rooms where there is an additional coin.
To go to the next level, you need to collect all the coins.

tags.feature: Added teleports and micro rooms where there is an additional coin.
